metadata.datasource: Measured off HARMAN technology, ILFORD DELTA 400 PROFESSIONAL technical information (Nov 2018), ID-11 stock 8 min at 24 C, intermittent agitation: the sheet's only characteristic curve, at Ilford's normal contrast (G-bar 0.62; the curve's own 0.64). Characteristic curve laid on agx's axis with the ISO speed point (0.10 over base + fog) 1.007 decades below mid-grey, box speed ISO 400; base + fog 0.281. Continued at its final gradient for 0.8 decades past the last plotted exposure. Spectral sensitivity: Ilford's wedge spectrogram to tungsten light, read as relative log sensitivity, as HP5 Plus's; Ortho Plus's own ratings, ISO 80 to daylight and 40 to tungsten, bear the reading out. One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
